tellings.link_reason: Same DOE headquarters hazing ritual, in which new appointees were told about aliens and Roswell technology, told firsthand by Mowatt-Larssen.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, who also worked at the US Department of Energy, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a prank played on newly appointed officials there in the late 2000s. He says that, in a secure vault at the department's Washington headquarters, new arrivals were given a mock briefing on a special access program (a tightly restricted secret project) claiming the government really had aliens, one injured and one not, and had taken alien technology from the famous crash at Roswell, New Mexico. He tells it, in two interviews that differ slightly on the years and once citing his book A State of Mind, as an inside joke that shows how the alien story was treated within government.
